_comment: Brands the collector knows about. source=shopify uses the store's public /products.json. source=affiliate means we still need a feed (e.g. Awin) - skipped for now. 'favourite' brands are ones the user already loves; Explore prefers the others.

brands.name: Wax London
brands.blurb: London label making relaxed, textured menswear with a strong focus on responsibly sourced fabrics.

brands.name: Percival
brands.blurb: Soho-born London brand: modern prep with playful knitwear and a 90s vintage wink.

brands.name: Alex Mill
brands.blurb: New York label doing easy, vintage-leaning American casualwear.

brands.name: Rains
brands.blurb: Danish rainwear brand: minimal, waterproof outerwear and bags with a clean Scandinavian look.

brands.name: Oliver Spencer
brands.blurb: London designer known for relaxed British tailoring and natural, characterful fabrics.

brands.name: Universal Works
brands.blurb: Nottingham brand mixing British workwear with a laid-back, colourful touch.

brands.name: Sunspel
brands.blurb: English brand making refined everyday essentials since 1860: tees, polos and knitwear done properly.

brands.name: Kestin
brands.blurb: Edinburgh brand blending Scottish heritage with Scandinavian-style utility and minimalism.

brands.name: Drake's
brands.blurb: London tie-maker turned full menswear house: soft tailoring, Ivy staples and English craft.

brands.name: Norse Projects
brands.blurb: Copenhagen label for functional, quietly minimal everyday clothing.

brands.name: De Bonne Facture
brands.blurb: Paris brand reviving French workwear, made with small European workshops.

brands.name: Colhay's
brands.blurb: London knitwear specialist making vintage-inspired jumpers and cardigans.

brands.name: Albam
brands.blurb: British modern essentials with a utilitarian edge, made with long-standing factories.

brands.name: Folk
brands.blurb: London label for considered, texture-rich everyday clothing with subtle design details.

brands.name: Private White V.C.
brands.blurb: Manchester-made outerwear and heritage pieces from their own historic factory.

brands.name: Uskees
brands.blurb: British workwear-inspired brand: chore jackets, overalls and sturdy organic cotton.

brands.name: Peregrine
brands.blurb: Family-run English knitwear maker: classic jumpers made in their own mill.

brands.name: Howlin'
brands.blurb: Belgian label making playful, colourful Scottish-knit wool jumpers.

brands.name: Arpenteur
brands.blurb: French brand making utilitarian, craft-led clothing in French workshops.

brands.name: Nigel Cabourn
brands.blurb: British designer known for vintage military and mountaineering-inspired pieces.

brands.name: YMC
brands.blurb: London label (You Must Create) with relaxed, slightly offbeat modern classics.

brands.name: Studio Nicholson
brands.blurb: London brand for relaxed, precise minimalism: wide trousers and fine fabrics.

brands.name: Mfpen
brands.blurb: Copenhagen label for clean, relaxed Scandinavian everyday clothing.

brands.name: Aimé Leon Dore
brands.blurb: New York label that mixes old-school prep and Ivy with modern streetwear.

brands.name: Rowing Blazers
brands.blurb: New York brand reviving preppy, sporting heritage with a playful twist.

brands.name: Anglo-Italian
brands.blurb: London tailoring house blending English cloth with relaxed Italian cuts.

brands.name: Taylor Stitch
brands.blurb: San Francisco brand for durable, responsible workwear-inspired staples.

brands.name: Ralph Lauren
brands.blurb: The American prep icon: Oxford shirts, cable knits and classic tailoring.

brands.name: Reiss
brands.blurb: London brand for sharp, contemporary smart-casual and tailoring.

brands.name: Arket
brands.blurb: Scandinavian modern basics with a clean, lasting design approach.

brands.name: COS
brands.blurb: Minimal, architectural modern essentials.

brands.name: Suitsupply
brands.blurb: Amsterdam tailoring house for well-cut suits, blazers and smart separates.
